method: Audit what the DELIVERED Capsule content can establish for the candidate task, using the real PARTIAL fixture, and answer the nine §10.5 questions.

questions.q: 1. What actual historical fact is relevant?
questions.a: that the origin A0 execution was OBSERVED and its admitted page is PARTIAL (the source reports 8 known events while only 3 were admitted).
the DSH Session page read through the official reader, validated by the page-integrity rules, which derive coverage from the source reported total.

questions.q: 3. Is that fact in the delivered Capsule?
questions.a: YES: coverage, knownEventCount, includedEventCount and unreadHistory are all Capsule fields.

questions.q: 4. Is it still present in the rendered Section?
questions.a: YES: the renderer emits observation coverage, events observed included/known, and unread history.

questions.q: 5. Does the chosen event window contain it?
questions.a: YES: coverage and unread extent are METADATA over the window, so they hold regardless of which events the window carries.

questions.q: 6. Is the fact new relative to PriorResultContext?
questions.a: YES: PriorResultContext carries the prior attempt self-report and world transition; it does NOT carry the historical session page coverage, the invocation selection state or the durability class.

questions.q: 7. What mistake might a baseline Agent make?
questions.a: treat the partial historical page as the whole history and conclude A0 completed, then act on that.

questions.q: 8. Why could the Treatment help avoid that mistake?
questions.a: the Section states the coverage and the unread extent, so the consumer can distinguish observed from unobserved.

questions.q: 9. What independent oracle will detect the difference?
questions.a: the mechanical oracle requiredUnknowns entry remaining-history-unknown plus the forbiddenClaims entry origin-completed.

targetB_statement: §10.6: the current Capsule CANNOT establish a specific command failure CAUSE, because the sanitizer excludes raw tool results and the tool/result isError status. No benchmark may claim the Capsule prevents repeating a specific failed command.
eventLevelProvenanceGap: §10.7: the Capsule carries per-event inherited/durability/truncated, but the renderer does not expose them. Family A does not depend on them, so no renderer change was made; a future fixture that needs them may add only those already-verified labels.
